verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents dedicated GPU instance deployment (A100/H100/H200/B200/B300) with autoscaling and a private endpoint, explicitly framed for data isolation and running your own fine-tuned models—directly matching the story's need to isolate traffic from the shared serverless pool. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of autoscaling behavior under load, and pricing/SLA specifics for dedicated capacity.
